exposure: type of donation (double gamete vs. oocyte donation alone)
cohort: This study included 247 women aged 43 and older who became pregnant after oocyte donation and gave birth between 2010 and 2016 in a tertiary maternity center.
finding: There were no significant differences in obstetric or perinatal complications between women who underwent double gamete donation and those who underwent oocyte donation alone, except for a higher risk of gestational diabetes in the double donation group.
